title: The Map That Smelled Like Rain
moral: Fixing problems with patience leads to success.

scenes.text: Milo discovers an old map in the library that hints at hidden treasure.
scenes.image_prompt: kids in library opening old map glowing softly

scenes.summary: They head to a dangerous marsh.
scenes.text: They travel to Willowmire marsh despite warnings and uncertainty.
scenes.image_prompt: kids walking through marsh with reeds and muddy path

scenes.text: They enter a pumping station and find a hidden underground puzzle chamber.
scenes.image_prompt: old underground room with chest and puzzle lock

scenes.text: Milo carefully fixes the mechanism instead of forcing it open.
scenes.image_prompt: boy repairing mechanical lock with tools and focus

scenes.text: Through patience and teamwork, they open the chest and succeed.
scenes.image_prompt: friends opening treasure chest glowing warmly

story: Milo and his friends discover a mysterious map and follow it into a marsh where they find a hidden puzzle chest. Instead of forcing it open, Milo repairs the mechanism with care. Their patience and teamwork lead them to success.
